personal.name: Mauricio Belusso
personal.title: Staff Backend & Platform Engineer
personal.summary: Backend engineer working on distributed systems and JVM runtime optimization in production. In FinOps, reduced AWS EKS compute cost by 85%. Work includes Virtual Threads on Java 25 LTS and batch pipelines of hundreds of thousands of records. Scope covers memory-leak fixes and the modernization of legacy monoliths into decoupled, observable platforms.
personal.contactHeadline: Architecture, distributed systems, and infrastructure cost.
personal.contactBody: I am open to conversations about architecture, production systems, and cloud-cost optimization.

highlights.title: High-Frequency Transactional API Optimization
highlights.description: Diagnosed, with advanced profiling, and fixed a critical memory leak in an endpoint exposed to automation bots. Reduced required infrastructure from 12 pods (3GB RAM each) to only 1–2 pods (1.5GB RAM), eliminating Out-of-Memory (OOM) crashes in production.

diagram.title: Twelve pods hitting OOM reduced to one or two stable pods
diagram.caption: Profiling cuts the heap. EKS compute drops 85%.

highlights.title: Highly Scalable Batch Processing
highlights.description: Architected scalable AWS SQS flows for private credit annotation and reconciliation (PEFIN, REFIN, and CONVEM), processing up to 300 thousand tax IDs (CPF/CNPJ) in a single run with no impact on availability.

diagram.title: Credit-restriction batch decoupled from the API
diagram.caption: Up to 300 thousand tax IDs. The API stays available.

highlights.title: Migration to Java 25 LTS and Virtual Threads
highlights.description: Led the modernization of microservices from Java 8 to 25 LTS. Adopted Virtual Threads, cutting average CPU consumption by 70% and memory from 1.3 GB to 900 MB — a level held under high load — while mitigating physical-thread blocking (carrier thread pinning) in synchronized blocks.

diagram.title: Pinned platform thread against a Java 25 virtual thread
diagram.caption: CPU from 100 to 30 mcores. Memory from 1.3 GB to 900 MB under load.

highlights.title: Dynamic Variable Substitution Engine
highlights.description: Built a notification-document rendering engine. The operations team now publishes new layouts without code or deploys.

diagram.title: Operations publishes the layout without a deploy
diagram.caption: What used to take weeks now ships immediately.

achievements: Led an 85% infrastructure-cost reduction for a critical API on AWS EKS.
Architected decoupled batch solutions on AWS SQS for processing credit-restriction records.
Real-time channels with native authenticated WebSockets and decoupled uploads via S3 Signed URLs.
Ongoing migration of the microservices ecosystem to Java 25 LTS with Virtual Threads, reducing CPU from 100 to 30 mcores and memory from 1.3 GB to 900 MB even under high load.
NoSQL database tuning (MongoDB), explain-plan analysis, and index application via Mongock without deploy locks.
Developed a proprietary annotation-based dependency-injection framework to decouple a legacy monolith, cutting production defects by 60% and code structural complexity by 70%.
Integrated critical transactional systems with financial institutions and credit unions via secure REST APIs connected to BACEN, ensuring regulatory compliance across sensitive data flows.
Defined the technology stack and solution architecture for the INCRA public-notice automation project.
Engineered the automated notice-generation module, eliminating manual processes and compressing document drafting time.
Implemented ICP-Brasil digital-certificate signing and gov.br authentication integration, enabling candidates to apply directly with legal validity.
Set up the CI/CD pipeline (GitLab) from the project's inception, automating build, tests, and deploy.
Managed CI/CD pipelines for a fleet of 70+ Java microservices on the SuperApp Porto Seguro project, cutting deploy time from 20 to 8 minutes (-60%).
Built an observability stack (ELK/Kibana, OpenSearch, AWS CloudWatch, AppDynamics) for real-time monitoring of distributed systems, including Terraform provisioning of ELK across the fleet.
Engineered origin identification (IP, device, and user) via User-Agent analysis, increasing troubleshooting precision by channel.
Modernized the integration between the legacy desktop system and a stateless REST microservice in Java/Spring Boot, enabling expansion to the Android mobile platform.
Led the Sales Platform Web product technically, defining architecture standards and code-review criteria for the engineering team.
Deployed a CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins), automating continuous build and deploy for the platform.

skills.description: Java 8–25, Spring Boot, and Virtual Threads.
Infrastructure as code, containerization, and cloud-cost optimization.
AI-assisted engineering, with technical review of architecture, security, and business rules, and real-time microservice monitoring.

platform.title: What runs in production
platform.body: The transactional API runs on EKS. Batch goes to SQS, files leave through S3 signed URLs, the live channel is WebSocket, and state sits in MongoDB.
